title: CUA-Recovery: Benchmarking Error Recovery in Long-Horizon Computer-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.27645v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As computer-use agents (CUAs) move to long-horizon workflows spanning multiple applications, undetected errors can silently corrupt persistent state and cause cascading failures in subsequent actions. Reliable error detection and recovery have become critical bottlenecks for building robust CUAs. However, existing benchmarks focus primarily on end-to-end task performance, providing limited insight into whether agents can detect and recover from errors during execution. The few benchmarks that evaluate recovery rely largely on manually injected errors, which may not reflect the types or horizons of failures induced by real agent policies. We introduce CUA-Recovery, a benchmark comprising test and training suites across multiple desktop applications. translated_title: CUA-Recovery：面向长时程计算机使用智能体的错误恢复基准测试
translated_abstract: 随着计算机使用智能体（CUA）逐渐转向跨越多个应用程序的长时程工作流，未被检测到的错误可能会悄无声息地破坏持久化状态，并在后续动作中引发级联失效。可靠的错误检测与恢复已成为构建稳健 CUA 的关键瓶颈。然而，现有基准主要关注端到端任务性能，对于智能体能否在执行过程中检测错误并从中恢复的洞察十分有限。少数评估恢复能力的基准在很大程度上依赖人工注入的错误，这可能无法反映真实智能体策略所引发错误的类型或时程范围。我们提出了 CUA-Recovery，这是一个由覆盖多个桌面应用程序的测试集和训练集组成的基准。我们使用 ReRail 来构建该基准，ReRail 是一个在持久化桌面环境中合成长时程任务与轨迹的框架。ReRail 将 MyPCBench 任务组合成新的长时程工作流……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了 CUA-Recovery 基准和 ReRail 框架，通过在持久化桌面环境中将任务组合成长时程工作流来系统评估计算机使用智能体的错误检测与恢复能力，弥补了现有基准依赖人工注入错误、无法反映真实智能体策略所致失败的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CUA-Recovery, a benchmark built with the ReRail framework that synthesizes long-horizon tasks and trajectories in a persistent desktop environment to systematically evaluate error detection and recovery in computer-use agents, addressing the limitations of existing benchmarks that rely on manually injected errors.
